[CONT](VC):During your turn, all of your front row rear-guards get [Power]+5000 for each of your "Distorted Bane" regress gauges.
[AUTO](VC):When this unit attacks, [COST][Soul-Blast 1], choose a card from your (RC) or hand, and put it face up as a regress gauge. If you put a card, this unit gets "Triple Drive" until end of turn.
[Divine Skill] - [AUTO](VC):At the end of the battle this unit attacked, if you have five or more regress gauges, [COST][discard two cards from hand], and you get an additional turn. During that additional turn, this unit gets drive -1, and you skip the ride phase and main phase of that additional turn.

[AUTO](RC):When this unit attacks a vanguard, if you have a grade 3 or greater vanguard with "Liael" in its card name, until end of that battle, this unit gets [Power]+5000, if you have three or more regress gauges, [COST][Energy-Blast 2], choose one of your opponent's rear-guards, and retire it.

Shuffle the deck.
